title: Easiest agentic automation for your business
description: The easiest agentic AI automation you can build for your business takes about five minutes, and most people are sleeping on the feature that does it. Claude Code has a routines tab built right in that schedules a prompt to fire at any time of day inside a folder on your machine. You drop your resources into that folder so the agent reads them like a knowledge base, write the prompt for the workflow you want, flip on bypass permissions so it runs fully on its own, and pick when it runs. Mine deploys a swarm of sub agents to research the top trending products, run the sourcing math, and drop a full report into my deliverables folder every day without me touching it. That is the simplest version. I go through all the advanced features in my full Claude Code masterclass inside my community. Link in bio.
